translation.name: Waom Yesu Wane Sigi Maep Don

content: Anutu Wane Don Kine Tewekei Wane, Yesuŋo Ra Qelaŋange
Naso yewao Parisi so ra rokop don Kito ebo ebon natne, eŋe Yerusalem ŋine sariu paki, Yesu qesonka rakoi,
“Kine onoka wane geŋane dokoŋone eŋe ŋenane aso ŋabo kopze eŋane don numa ŋebongoi, ea mi tewekmami? Onoka wane eŋe numa maine mogare meteene saukeu paki, ŋara mi ma ne okanmami?”
Yesuŋo mainge edane rake, “Pakimo ŋine onoka wane Anutu wane ra rokop don ea ŋadekkau paki, ŋinŋine don numa ea mogare ma gemami?
Anutuŋo iwa yale rake, ‘Ge magaŋone so nagaŋone eweetne kitokene,’ So rake, ‘Ŋei mane eŋe naga magaine erane don borikine rayake, eŋe siluŋ qeu seukeake.’

Ŋo ŋido kito edanmami, yemo ŋei mane eŋe yeye mane mageakeo, yemo eŋe magaine me nagaine maine eaŋo qesiŋotki rap, ŋo siluŋ ramaike, ‘Iwa mo Anutu wane biŋek qekole,’ yemo yaup isioniake, ŋo yemo eŋine biŋek,
numa yaline eŋe magaine ewino mi kitomaike, ŋine yale okanbi paki, Anutu wane don mapapkau paki, ŋinŋine don numa ea teweke mogare ari okanmami.
Ŋine isi ŋei nau! Propet Isaia eŋe don koboboine ŋinane iwa yale maine rake!

content.text: ‘Anutuŋo ramaike, ŋei ŋerep iwa eŋe pieneŋoka mawa nanmami, ŋo weteneŋo yemo kakaknane more eri abaran gemami.
Onoka wane eŋe kepe ŋeiŋo don numa motmole, ea tewekeu paki ra okanmami, Iwa Anutu wane ra rokop don. Eŋe yalineŋo na mawa nanbi rap, yemo mi menaŋgi rap’”

content: Kine Kine Iwaŋo Maki Ŋei Mane Eŋe Wetine Sigitne Okan Okanmaike
Yesu eŋe ŋei ŋerep magu edoraki, eŋano ariu edane rake, “Ketŋine motpi paki detlukeu, ŋine misuk ŋaŋaekei!

Ŋei mane eŋe nene kine kine aŋainoka neki kotino wete okanmaike, eaŋo maki kotino mi sigile okanmaike, midakaka! Kotino don kine kine qotkoine wetke mage more, koso aŋaineŋo raki saketmaike, eaŋoka maki ŋei ea kotine sigile okanmaike.”
Pakiso dokoine eŋe eaka sari qesonka rakoi, “Ge don iwa ranom, Parisi eŋe dere worik detpi, ea detmaine?”
Yesuŋo edane rake, “Waet kine kine korop Magane qeliwo gemaike, oŋo mi ebotke, eamo baŋ kinerop lokak wareake,
eŋane ra more dere mezet mi okanbi, ŋetne magu ea eŋe deene pili pilikine, eŋe yalinane de pilik maneŋo de pilik mane iwenkaki, ari eret narek lom maneo ketmamik.”
Raki Petoroŋo rake, “Don naŋengo ramaine, ea wane kine ŋedannom detŋem.”
Yesuŋo edane rake, “Ŋine yaleka wet dereret ŋine manerop natne eŋane wet dereret mane mi yuankamaike.
Ŋine mi detmami me? Kine kine mane ŋei maneŋo aŋainoka neki, wete kobaŋino ketmaike, paki koso kainoka tetki saket arimaike.
Ŋo kine kine aŋaoka saketmaike, eamo korop wetko ŋine sari saketmaike, kine kine yalineŋo maki ŋei mane wetine sigilemaike.

Onoka wane eŋine kotino ŋine borikinane dereret ea wetkeki, eaŋo tebaka ari biraki kawali engu seuk marat kamaike, ŋerep mane qelige mane mama, bailalaŋ okane, ŋerep yau yaup ebu ebu, aboŋ kobu mama, isi don rara, so gube qesat don natne edanikei.
Kine kine ea, edo mau ŋei mane wane wetine di kito okanmaike. Ŋo eŋe yale ramami, mete mi sau sauk yaup ŋara ma nene, eaŋo maki ŋei mane wetine sigileake, midaka, eaŋo maki mi sigile okanmaike.”
Kanan Qelaŋ Ŋerep Maneŋo Yesu Detlukka Malipkake
Yesu eŋe mat ea qelige more, kepe sai mane Tire so Sidon mat osino pake, ea arike.

Kanan qelaŋ ŋerep mane eŋe kepe ea geke, oŋo Yesu wano sariki paki, ra arok okanka rake, “Suaine, Dawit wane qerakine, Anutuŋo biragangi ketkone! Ge naŋane wetŋone borikep! Naŋane borasone eŋe asu qotkoineŋo kotino pa matalikaki, wikile zok detmaike.”
Yale raki, Yesuŋo don mane mi olatke, eŋine dokoine eŋe eŋano sari raka rakoi, “Talekanom eŋe arikep! Eŋe ŋenane ŋadezo ra aroke sarimaike!”
Yesuŋo mainge rake, “Na lama yeo me yeo ket ari gemami, Israel ŋei ŋerep magu eŋaneka weku talenangi ketkole.”
Raki eaka ŋerep eŋe osino sari wawetineŋo kino qe more umi qe rake, “Suaine, mapik nannom!”
Yesuŋo olatke, “Ŋerep ŋene maine Israel medep eŋane ŋara ea ma more, koso qelaŋ kasi eaŋo qakŋem ariki nene, eamo mi menaŋmaike.”
Ŋerepŋo mainge rake, “Suaine, ea welekatne, ŋo siluŋ kasimze eŋe welakopene eŋane zakeo ŋine ne yuankau, sisinemde ketki eŋe weneŋ ne okanmami.”
Eso Yesuŋo mainge ŋerep olale rake, “O ŋerep, ge mali malipŋone kakapa! Ge onokaka wane ganmaike paki ramaine, yale baŋ okanganiake.” Eso naso eaka borasine menaŋkake.
Yesuŋo Ŋei Loutne Ma Menaŋonge
Yesu eŋe mat ea qelige more, Galili doku namuŋ ea mogare arike, eŋe ari meŋo waki paki, pese ket metke.

Metki, ŋei ŋerep magu suaine eŋe eŋano sarikoi. Eŋe kie pekinene qoiqoine, depilik, kie mete seu seune, don mi raraine, so zoma kine kine natne loutne weneŋ ebu sari, Yesu wane kino biraongoi, pakiso Yesuŋo ebuki menaŋ warekoi.

Ŋei ŋerep eŋe welelepkekoi, onoka wane eŋe onbi donene mi raraine edo don ramaŋkoi, kie mete seu seune eŋe menaŋmaŋkoi, kie wawetene me pekinene qoqoine eŋe numa gegeene wakonmaŋke, de pilik eŋe deene potmaŋkoi, eso ea wane eŋe Israel eŋane Anutu mawakakoi.
Yesuŋo Ŋei Ŋerep 4, 000 Ŋara Gumeonge

Yesu eŋe dokoine edoraki ariu edane rake, “Na ŋei ŋerep iwa eŋane wetne borimaike, onoka wane eŋe narop kaiwe karewe gemami paki, ukude ŋara mane mi nemami. Na ŋara mi gumeon gumeon yaup taleonŋem arikei wane mi nanmaike, onoka wane eŋe mateno arikei wane, ari numao zonomene midayakane.”
Dokoine eŋe olale rakoi, “Ŋene ŋara sai togolo iwa maratka more, ŋei ŋerep magu iwa gumeonŋem, maine rokop oniake!”
Yesuŋo edane rake, “Ŋine ŋara darap magemami sikan nanbi!” Eŋe olale rakoi, “Bret sewen so zawon mida nigatne etkemde ma gemaine.”
Eso Yesu eŋe mo ea ŋei ŋerep magu ea raongi, kepo dara wuruk pese ket met warekoi.
Pakiso, eŋe bret sewen so zawon ea maki paki, Anutu bakomine kito more, mapokki waki dokoine ebonge, eso dokoine eŋe ma more damo qe, ŋei ŋerep ebon warekoi.
Eŋe korop neu ŋatene qewareke, dokoine eŋe neu wokitne metke, ea mau ket rosa sewen watkeke.
Ŋei ŋara nekoi, eŋane zaleene 4, 000, ŋerep so medep nigatne yemo mi dapotongoi.
Eso Yesu eŋe mo ea ŋei ŋerep taleongi, mateno ari wareu, eŋine seki koto waketki, pakiso Magadan kepe sai ea arike.
